title: Red Hat Security Advisory: delve security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description: This advisory addresses multiple security vulnerabilities in the Go programming language's crypto/tls and crypto/x509 packages, fixed in an update to the Delve debugger version 1.27 for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9. The issues include denial of service via indefinite KeyUpdate messages and multiple ECH outer extension references, as well as man-in-the-middle attacks via untrusted intermediate certificates. The update mitigates these vulnerabilities by incorporating fixes in the underlying Go libraries used by Delve.
